summary.name: AgentSEO
summary.one_liner: AgentSEO is an SEO API and MCP server that gives AI agents and developer workflows compact, deterministic JSON SERP data for rank tracking, content gaps, local visibility, and AI search monitoring.
use_cases: Track keyword and URL rankings for clients
Find content gaps versus SERP competitors
Monitor local search visibility by location
Track brand mentions in AI search and LLM answers
Build SEO agents that call SEO data through MCP
Generate content briefs and outlines from competitor headers
summary.what_it_does: AgentSEO provides SEO data workflows through a REST API and an MCP server, with an SDK and integration guides for tools like n8n, Codex, OpenClaw, and Claude Desktop. Its covered areas include SERP analysis, keyword and URL rank tracking, local visibility checks, and volatility checks. It also offers keyword ideas and metrics, clustering, ranked keywords, domain competitors, and traffic estimates. Content features include gap analysis, briefs, outlines, internal links, refresh plans, decay detection, and pre-publish QA, while AI features cover AI Overview extraction, prompt-set and LLM mention tracking, backlink analysis, and social listening. Responses are described as deterministic JSON with a markdown summary, and synchronous or asynchronous job modes are offered.
notable: MCP server and REST API sharing one contract
Deterministic JSON output with markdown_summary for Slack or email
Sync and async job modes with idempotency-key retry support
Compact SERP payloads; page reports 72.6% smaller enriched payloads in a three-query comparison
caveats: Ongoing use requires a paid plan after 100 one-time free credits; paid tiers start at $9/month
The 72.6% payload reduction is from a bounded three-query comparison and is not a token, latency, or cost guarantee
Local visibility example covers one sampled keyword/location pair and omits impressions, calls, and conversions
